data.name: Lemian
data.gender_notes: Lemian is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word lehiym, meaning 'to heal'. In the Old Testament, God is described as the healer of his people. In Christian tradition, the name Lemian symbolizes the healing power of God and the hope for divine intervention in times of distress. The name Lemian carries the meaning “Divine healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Lemian usually hope their child will grow to embody divine healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the hope and trust in God's healing power.
data.etymology: Lemian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine healer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lemian total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Lemians use various platforms such as OpenSea, Rarible, and Lemuria to sell their NFT artwork directly to buyers. These platforms allow artists to mint, sell, and trade their digital artwork as NFTs.
